page_title: BOL 2-1 ACM | Bologna v AC Milan 27/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag. Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
90+4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+4' Golden chance! Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
88' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game. One of the players from Bologna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to AC Milan.
87' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo De Silvestri will be replaced by Davide Calabria (Bologna).
84' It is time for a substitution. Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is on for Alejandro Jimenez.
82' 2 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Cambiaghi puts a cross into the box and finds Dan Ndoye (Bologna), who latches on to it and strikes the ball low into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:1.
82' What a chance! Nicolo Casale (Bologna) rises high to connect with the resulting corner inside the box, but his bullet header rattles the right post.
80' Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
80' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Benjamin Dominguez and he is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
79' Santiago Castro comes off the pitch to be replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
79' Lukasz Skorupski makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Luka Jovic (AC Milan) after a cross from the side.
77' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
76' Sergio Conceicao has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luka Jovic (AC Milan) replacing Santiago Tomas Gimenez.
76' The game is interrupted. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
74' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes the corner but it's cleared.
74' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) sends a long ball in, but Mike Maignan comfortably gathers the ball.
72' Here is a change. Giovanni Fabbian is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
72' Substitution. Lewis Ferguson makes his way off the pitch and Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
70' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
69' The corner from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is cleared away by the defence.
68' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. AC Milan win a corner.
68' Juan Miranda (Bologna) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
67' Santiago Castro (Bologna) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
66' Santiago Castro (Bologna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The linesman signals a throw-in for AC Milan.
65' AC Milan take a short corner kick.

64' Lukasz Skorupski pulls off a great save to deny Yunus Musah (AC Milan) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
63' AC Milan concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
62' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
61' The substitution has been made. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has replaced Joao Felix.
59' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
57' The referee blows his whistle as Santiago Castro (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
56' Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul after Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
55' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
55' Foul! Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
54' Today's referee Maurizio Mariani rightly decides to book Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) for his harsh tackle.
53' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) sees a yellow card from Maurizio Mariani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
52' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
51' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Bologna players have a reason to celebrate!
50' The Bologna players halt their celebrations as referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
48' 1 - 1 Santiago Castro (Bologna) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
47' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
46' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
46' Referee Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' 0 - 1 What a magnificent finish! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) wonderfully times his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the left side of the net!
41' 63:37 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
41' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
40' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) was too forceful with his tackle and Maurizio Mariani interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
38' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Mike Maignan is alert and denies him with a nice save.
37' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
34' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

33' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
32' One of the AC Milan players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
29' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Mike Maignan (AC Milan).
28' Juan Miranda (Bologna) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
27' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
26' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Maurizio Mariani no option but to blow his whistle.
25' What a big chance! Dan Ndoye (Bologna) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
23' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
23' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
19' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
18' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
17' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
17' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Lukasz Skorupski.
16' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and it's Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
12' Sam Beukema (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
11' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
9' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
6' Santiago Castro (Bologna) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
6' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan).
4' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' That's a well-taken pass by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bologna will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maurizio Mariani.
